description: Get income statement, balance sheet and cash flow data for a company (revenue, profitability, debt, cash position) from SEC XBRL filings. The response carries BOTH the annual and the quarterly series (no separate trailing-twelve-month series: sum the last four quarters for TTM flow figures). HTTP 404 "Company not found" / "No SEC XBRL financials" means the issuer has no SEC XBRL financials in Signal8 (e.g. a foreign OTC issuer that files nothing with the SEC): a coverage gap, not a bad call. costOfRevenueBasis states what costOfRevenue measures: "excludes_depreciation_amortization" when the filer tags only a cost line without depreciation and amortization, so a margin from it is on that basis. grossProfit and grossMargin are null when not measured (no GrossProfit tag and no cost-of-revenue tag, as at banks and most REITs); a null margin is not a 100% margin. grossProfitSource is "reported" or "revenue_minus_cost". Balance-sheet totalDebt = current + noncurrent borrowings + convertible notes + finance leases from that balance sheet; operating lease liabilities are not included (they are operatingLeaseLiability); for the newest balance sheets it is summed from the filing's own balance-sheet lines. A balance sheet that was read, agrees with the tagged facts and lists no borrowings gives a measured totalDebt of 0 (totalDebtBasis.method "balance_sheet_no_debt_lines"). Related-party loans the notes describe as repayable and liabilities for sold future revenues or royalties count; related-party balances the notes leave unexplained, expenses a related party paid for the company, share subscription advances and card payables are excluded; when the note splits a related-party balance into a loan and other amounts, only the loan part counts. For lenders, nonrecourse securitisation debt and deposits are excluded. totalDebtBasis gives what it includes, the lines behind it (concept tag, bucket, value, caption) and data-quality flags; netDebt = totalDebt - cash. A null totalDebt is not measured, not zero.

limit.description: Maximum number of periods per series (1-40). Defaults to 8.

ticker.description: Company identifier: the current ticker (e.g. "AAPL"), a former ticker of a renamed or delisted company (e.g. "MIGI", now BGDE), or a numeric SEC CIK (e.g. "320193" or "0000320193"). A former ticker or a CIK is answered with a `resolvedFrom` block naming the current symbol.

type.description: Accepted for compatibility; the response always carries both annual and quarterly periods.

name: get_financials
title: Get Financial Statements
